title: M3 Motorway Closed Due to Dense Fog
excerpt: Authorities have temporarily closed a key section of the M3 Motorway between Faizpur and Jaranwala due to heavy fog.
body_html:
A major motorway section in Pakistan has been temporarily shut down as a result of heavy fog limiting visibility.

According to Syed Imran Ahmed, a spokesperson for the relevant authorities, the M3 Motorway is currently closed for travel between Faizpur and Jaranwala.

Drivers and commuters are advised to stay updated on road conditions and plan their travel accordingly while the closure remains in effect.
